text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...Only the sound of the wind.
Running at my own speed, taking in my own scenery.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Quiet, and so peaceful——)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaahhhh!!
I'm so frusssstrateddddddd!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I lost I lost I lost-aaah!!
I lost to Kitasan~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew, no way, no way!
I barely managed it by the skin of my teeth!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san, you went zooming ahead at such
an insane speed!
I was on the edge of my seat wondering if I could even catch up!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...At an insane... speed...)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But you still caught up with me~~!
Guuuhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
One more! Let's do it one more time!
Next time my Turbo Engine won't run out!
I'm gonna front-run all the way to the end~~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Front-running all the way to the end...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No way, Suzuka-san,
you're going to run with us too?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of you, I just couldn't resist...
I hope I'm not intruding?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Your running style
is what we look up to, after all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But Turbo's gonna win!
'Cause I'm gonna leave Suzuka in the dust too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Well then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: On your marks, get set——go!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Front-running with everything from the start.
Breaking away from the pack to take the very front——)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (I understand that feeling. It's where it feels best, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Even rounding the fourth corner,
charging ahead entirely alone at the front.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ——Haah!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Vigilantly chasing heat from behind——
footsteps inching closer and closer.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...But none of that matters.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because the lead belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
(So... incredible...!
She can go even faster!?)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
(Heheh, what is that, what is that!
I'm gonna do it! I wanna do it! So far ahead
that super-duper no one can ever catch up!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I... I'm not gonna give up
either!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how far she runs away...
I want to catch up to that back!
I will catch her, no matter what!!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the road, I noticed a crowd
of spectators along the path talking about the three
horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That girl running in the lead was Silence Suzuka,
right? She was incredible!
Shooting out ahead in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did you see how her juniors ran, though?
They were just as thrilling to watch as Suzuka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! The way of running shown by a senior
really gets passed down to the juniors, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Watching someone's back and growing from it, huh...
Everyone is inspired to dream, isn't that right?
Everyone is inspired to dream, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! The way of running shown by a senior
really gets passed down to the juniors, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Watching someone's back and growing from it, huh...
Everyone is inspired to dream, isn't that right?
Everyone is inspired to dream, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's Suzuka-san for you...!
Next time, though, I won't lose~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, the view from the front truly is special, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Though, I won't yield it so easily next time either, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sight of her sprinting past, leaving everything
in her wake, never fails to captivate people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying wills and memories, the runners race forward.
And so, we will surely be captivated once again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff...
Grrr, next time! Next time I'm staying in first the whole way~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To the romance... of the lead——
